scenario_description:
Objective: Use a limited sealed citrus-purée surplus to enrich an optional portfolio flavor-and-set test during a newly open practice bench.
Emerging Need: The possibility is unusable while quality control and hold terms are absent; it becomes actionable only once a verified chilled-desk route, funds, lot code, price, and pickup window align.
Decision Context: Stored notes distinguish this from ordinary leftovers by naming the prepared test plan, spending cap, sealed-pack requirement, and no-credit/no-resale limits.
Consequence: A timely hold could improve a learner-owned formula experiment; missing the hold window leaves coursework, requirements, grades, and normal practice unaffected.
